subject: Compare the certificate CN over its whole length (#4577)
reason: The change only alters tlsGetPeerUser() CN matching for TLS client-certificate authentication (tls-auth-clients-user CN): it compares the certificate CN over its full length so an embedded NUL can no longer truncate 'Client-only\0attacker' into the user 'Client-only'. Exercising it requires a TLS listener with tls-auth-clients-user=CN and a client that presents an X.509 client certificate with an embedded NUL in its CN.
